issues.explanation: Ep7 states Sam's surgery was a complete success, but Ep9 says Sam is still waiting for surgery with the date repeatedly pushed back.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Maya's line in Ep9 to refer to Sam's follow-up care or recovery, e.g. 'Sam is still recovering; the doctors keep pushing his discharge date.'

issues.explanation: Ep2 establishes that Adrian's father died in a crash five years ago, but in Ep9 Adrian says he will ask his father for help tonight.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the line to another living person, e.g. 'I'll ask my father's old lawyer tonight,' or 'I'll ask Chloe tonight.'

issues.explanation: Ep7 shows Vanessa worked in the marketing department at Cross Tower, but Ep9 says she was head of legal at Cross Capital.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Vanessa's line to 'When I was in marketing at Cross Capital, I saw every contract he signed.'
